issues.detail: Blackout pleats read as thin grooves on flat slats, not alternating pleat facets
issues.problem: The s_pleat stripe fixed the moire but did not add pleat character. Up close, the crests are evenly lit (163-166 across ~5 px) and broken by a 1-2 px dark line: dark fraction 0.26, cv 0.165. In omaat_room24 the lit upper and shaded lower facets alternate about 50/50 (dark fraction 0.52, cv 0.35, p5/p95 0.38 against our 0.57). This is the hero element of every closed F/J window.
issues.evidence: b_jClose col 300 profile (e.g. 160 156 118 95 150 164 166 166 163 157 140 101 129 161 ...) against room24 col 620 (177..209 / 71..103 bands of equal width). Crops ra13/z_jclose_w13.png and ra13/room24_small.png.
issues.fix: Shape the s_pleat tile (make_swatches.py) as a sawtooth/asymmetric ramp instead of a narrow notch: crest 1.0 falling linearly to ~0.55 over ~55% of the period, then a quick rise. That puts a lit facet and a shaded facet in every pleat and keeps the mip-to-flat behaviour. If that is too dark in the mean, lift the blackout albedo ~5% to hold 0.60 of the wall. Also check that the zig-zag geometry normals are not flattened by the layer (the w12 crest gradient is gone in w13).

issues.detail: Door viewing window still ~15-20% small and set low; shade tab undersized

The photo's tab is a broad stowed-shade lip (~0.7 of the opening width, ~0.14 of its height) with a grip slot. Ours is a 0.10 x 0.02 m bar.
